lines.line: Same page, two visits: eight hundred milliseconds, then forty.
lines.adds_information: The two numbers side by side let the viewer measure the gap themselves.

lines.line: The first visit fetches every file from a far away server.
lines.adds_information: A three-node diagram draws the long trip to a far server, which the sentence can only name.

lines.line: A cache keeps a copy close to you.
lines.adds_information: The same diagram with a cache node inserted shows the architectural change.

lines.line: So the second visit skips the trip, and is twenty times faster.
lines.adds_information: A count-up stat card (real HyperFrames block) shows 20x climbing on the word twenty.
An end card with the exact keyword makes the one ask unmissable.
